import unittest
from solution import prepare_quotes


class QuoteIntegerPriceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_large_equal_finite_prices_have_zero_changes_and_ranges(self):
        n = 10**400
        rows = [{"day": "2024-01-01", "open": n, "close": n}, {"day": "2024-01-02", "open": n, "close": n}]
        result = prepare_quotes(rows, "2024-01-01")
        self.assertEqual(result["train"][0]["open"], 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(result["train"][0]["fractional_change"], 0.0)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()

import math
import unittest
from copy import deepcopy

from solution import prepare_quotes


class PrepareQuotesTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_partition_scaling_derivation_and_independence(self):
        rows = [
            {"day": "2024-01-01", "open": 10, "close": 20, "meta": {"x": [1]}},
            {"day": "2024-01-02", "open": 20, "close": 10, "meta": {"x": [2]}},
            {"day": "2024-01-03", "open": 30, "close": 15, "meta": {"x": [3]}},
            {"day": "2024-01-04", "open": 40, "close": 15, "meta": {"x": [4]}},
        ]
        original = deepcopy(rows)
        result = prepare_quotes(rows, "2024-01-02")
        self.assertEqual(result["scaler"], {"open": (10, 20), "close": (10, 20)})
        self.assertEqual(len(result["train"]), 2)
        self.assertEqual(len(result["test"]), 1)
        first, second = result["train"]
        self.assertEqual((first["open"], first["close"]), (0.0, 1.0))
        self.assertEqual((first["next_close"], first["change"], first["direction"]), (10, -10, -1))
        self.assertEqual(first["fractional_change"], -0.5)
        self.assertEqual((second["open"], second["close"]), (1.0, 0.0))
        self.assertEqual((second["next_close"], second["change"], second["direction"]), (15, 5, 1))
        self.assertEqual(second["fractional_change"], 0.5)
        test = result["test"][0]
        self.assertEqual((test["open"], test["close"]), (2.0, 0.5))
        self.assertEqual((test["next_close"], test["change"], test["direction"]), (15, 0, 0))
        self.assertEqual(test["fractional_change"], 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(rows, original)
        self.assertIsNot(first["meta"], rows[0]["meta"])
        self.assertIsNot(first["meta"]["x"], rows[0]["meta"]["x"])

    def test_zero_training_ranges_and_zero_close(self):
        rows = [
            {"day": "2024-02-28", "open": 5, "close": 0},
            {"day": "2024-02-29", "open": 5, "close": 0},
        ]
        result = prepare_quotes(rows, "2024-02-28")
        self.assertEqual(result["scaler"], {"open": (5, 5), "close": (0, 0)})
        self.assertEqual(result["train"][0]["open"], 0.0)
        self.assertEqual(result["train"][0]["close"], 0.0)
        self.assertIsNone(result["train"][0]["fractional_change"])
        self.assertEqual(result["test"], [])

    def test_malformed_inputs(self):
        valid = [
            {"day": "2024-01-01", "open": 1, "close": 2},
            {"day": "2024-01-02", "open": 2, "close": 3},
        ]
        bad_rows = [
            None,
            [],
            [valid[0]],
            [{"day": "2024-01-01", "open": 1}, valid[1]],
            [{"day": "2024-1-01", "open": 1, "close": 2}, valid[1]],
            [{"day": "2023-02-29", "open": 1, "close": 2}, valid[1]],
            [valid[1], valid[0]],
            [valid[0], dict(valid[0])],
            [{"day": "2024-01-01", "open": True, "close": 2}, valid[1]],
            [{"day": "2024-01-01", "open": math.inf, "close": 2}, valid[1]],
            [{"day": "2024-01-01", "open": 1, "close": math.nan}, valid[1]],
        ]
        for rows in bad_rows:
            with self.subTest(rows=rows):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    prepare_quotes(rows, "2024-01-01")
        for cutoff in ("2024-1-01", "2024-02-30", 20240101):
            with self.subTest(cutoff=cutoff):
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    prepare_quotes(valid, cutoff)
        with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
            prepare_quotes(valid, "2023-12-31")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
